integrity: Exact finite formulas follow from direct pair and overlapping-pair enumeration; multivariate central limit uses an analytic Hoeffding decomposition, not finite computer checks. Source date is the public arXiv v1 submission date.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform perfect matchings and counts of two-edge crossings/nestings; independent Gaussian weak limit, not finite independence; no convergence rate. Historical priority provisional because the earlier full bivariate enumerator may admit an unstated derivation.
title: Asymptotic independence of crossing and nesting counts in uniform chord diagrams
